game.title: Gears Tactics
game.blurb: Turn-based tactics game from Splash Damage and The Coalition, released 2020-04-28. RAWG average playtime: 7 hours. Genres: Strategy. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Campaign
chapters.summary: Finishing every Campaign Act on any difficulty, plus six hidden story milestones. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Hard Difficulty and Ironman
chapters.summary: Experienced and Insane runs, Ironman mode, a one-soldier Insane mission and the flawless Insane campaign.

chapters.title: Side Missions and Veteran Missions
chapters.summary: Sabotage, Scavenger Run, Control and Rescue side missions, and the Veteran missions.

chapters.title: Hero Skills and Weapon Mods
chapters.summary: Class skill combos (Rampage, Anchored, Teamwork, Avenger, Alpha and Omega, Breach) and Legendary weapon mods.

chapters.title: Combat Feats
chapters.summary: Kill counts, Ticker tricks, Emergence Holes, chainsaw executions, trick shots and missions with no one downed.

chapters.title: Jacked Game Mode
chapters.summary: Every achievement marked "Jacked game mode only", including the Brumak fight in Act 1 Chapter 6.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). The Steam schema calls the app "Glenwood" (an internal codename); the store list confirms app 1184050. 6 of 61 Steam achievements are hidden ("World on Fire", "Hell of a shot", "The bigger they are, the harder they fall", "Maybe too much spine...", "Broken hand, broken heart" and "Dead men tell no tales") and sit in the campaign chapter as a placeholder. "Seriously Tactical" (earn four other achievements) is in the difficulty chapter because it needs "Immortal Legion". StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0, marked as a stub). Only 4 subpages exist: "Achievements" (about 6,900 characters), "Characters" (about 550), "Enemies" (about 330) and "Table of Contents" (about 620); Walkthrough, Collectibles, Controls, Gameplay, Unlockables and Weapons are linked but not created, so nothing was used. gearsofwar.fandom.com answers the API, with about 182 linked pages; names only were looked at, nothing copied.
